description: Source code for a gzip HTTP handler middleware, providing gzip compression for HTTP responses with configurable options such as compression level, minimum size, and content types.

classes.name: GzipResponseWriter
classes.description: An http.ResponseWriter that compresses response data using gzip, with configurable minimum size and content types.

classes.name: GzipResponseWriterWithCloseNotify
classes.description: Wrapper for GzipResponseWriter that implements http.CloseNotifier.

classes.name: parsedContentType
classes.description: Represents a parsed media type and its parameters for content type matching.

classes.name: config
classes.description: Configuration struct for gzip handler options such as compression level, minimum size, and content types.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Appends data to the gzip writer or buffers it for later compression.

methods.name: startGzip
methods.description: Initializes gzip writer and writes buffered data.

methods.name: startPlain
methods.description: Switches to plain response without gzip compression.

methods.name: WriteHeader
methods.description: Saves the response status code for later use.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Obtains a gzip.Writer from the pool and resets it for use.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the gzip.Writer and returns it to the pool.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the gzip writer and the underlying ResponseWriter if applicable.

methods.name: Hijack
methods.description: Implements http.Hijacker if the underlying ResponseWriter supports it.
